result_summary: Independent audit found the low-wrapping transfer lemma sound conditional on stored KDG cable identifications and values.
Clarified a terminology hazard: the zero quantity in the two-parallel annulus argument is the ordinary link determinant V(L)(i)=Delta(L)(i), not Eisermann's reduced Jones determinant.
Identified the canonical four-parallel pattern P=z^4 as the first explicit degree-four ribbon pattern; P(U) is the four-component unlink and a(alpha)=1.
Reduced its direct KDG test to the existing order-five root-jet engine: exact delta^4 divisibility first, then quotient residue 25^4=1 mod 32.
Prepared a bounded reproducible runner with a 6_1^4 ribbon control and strict modular-vs-exact qualifications.
